oldContent: We Work Remotely: Remote jobs in design, programming, marketing and more https://weworkremotely.com/remote-jobs.rss We Work Remotely: Remote jobs in design, programming, marketing and more en-US 60 Hospitable: Customer Advocate Lead (North America - Remote) Anywhere in the World 🇨🇦 Canada and 🇺🇸 United States of America California Documentation, Technical Support, Troubleshooting, Customer Support, Onboarding, Leadership, and Team Management Customer Support Full-Time <p> <strong>Headquarters:</strong> United States <br /><strong>URL:</strong> <a href="https://hospitable.com/careers">https://hospitable.com/careers</a> </p> <p>tldr; We build software for Airbnbs to rent themselves, with a state-of-the-art product and user experience.</p> <p>We are bold, like risks, and take on big challenges together. We believe in the value of team diversity and seek candidates from a wide range of backgrounds in their work, life, culture, and experiences. We have crafted an Applicant Handbook, which we highly recommend you check out, where you can find out more about the company, culture, how we recruit, what we do, and how we do it: <a href="https://hsptb.com/hndbk">https://hsptb.com/hndbk</a></p> <p>Our customers love the product, provide valuable feedback, and trust us to rapidly help with their problems. Feel free to check out one of our&nbsp;public Town Halls&nbsp;for yourself: <a href="https://hsptb.com/twnhll">https://hsptb.com/twnhll</a></p> <p>Hospitable.com&nbsp;is a&nbsp;<strong>remote-only</strong>&nbsp;and&nbsp;<strong>fully&nbsp;distributed</strong> company. We hire based on timezones, not countries.</p> <h3>What you will be working on</h3> <p>As the Customer Advocate Lead, you will lead and empower our US support team to deliver an exceptional customer experience.&nbsp;</p> <p>Your first priority will be to hit consistent response times. We have a pretty solid foundation and our passionate team excels at delivering great experiences with our current processes—maintaining an average CSAT of 87%. We’re looking for someone who can take what’s working and make it even better.&nbsp;</p> <p>To accomplish this, you will:</p> <ul> <li>Manage queue distribution in our chat support system and workload across the US support team to maintain target response times and SLAs. We're aiming for a first response time of &lt;5mins for live chat and a total resolution time of 12h.</li> <li>Coach and develop team members through regular 1:1s, performance reviews, and real-time feedback.</li> <li>Handle technical troubleshooting and empower the team to resolve issues that require strong product and systems knowledge, as well as managing customer escalations and high-priority issues.</li> <li>Review and quality check team's support interactions and documentation.</li> <li>Train new team members on tools, processes, and product knowledge.</li> <li>Regularly work in the queue to stay connected to customer needs and model best practices for the team. You will typically spend 30-40% of your time in the queue.</li> <li>You will report to our Director of Support, and work with our other amazing support leads such as Kelly whose favorite fruit is dragon fruit.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Requirements</strong></h3> <p>For this position, we are looking to recruit someone in any of the US time zones. Candidates in countries outside of such time zones will not be considered.</p> <p>If you're hesitant to apply for this position because you feel that you don't meet this list of qualifications fully, don't worry! strategy initiatives</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p>The total rewards package at Mercury includes base salary, equity (stock options/RSUs), and benefits.</p> <p>Our salary and equity ranges are highly
